crossRefs.note: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings…
He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves…
I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings…
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
“When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
translations.bsb: For I am the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.
translations.kjv: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
translations.asv: For I am Jehovah that brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
